styles.name: starter-shell.css
styles.content: .wfs-site{margin:0;background:var(--wf-color-surface,#fff);color:var(--wf-color-text,#172c25);font-family:var(--wf-font-body,system-ui,sans-serif)}.wfs-site *{box-sizing:border-box}.wfs-site img{max-width:100%}.wfs-site main{min-height:65vh}.wfs-site h1,.wfs-site h2,.wfs-site h3,.wfs-site p{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.wfs-site a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:4px}
